summary: This clinical study compares adding the drug inclisiran to standard care versus standard care alone for adults with acute coronary syndrome. Acute coronary syndrome is a condition with sudden reduced blood flow to the heart. The study looks at changes in LDL-C, which is a type of cholesterol in the blood. Novartis Pharmaceuticals is sponsoring this Phase 4 trial, which aims to enroll 300 participants and is currently not yet recruiting.
